{{Top|leg}}
The '''Planetary Survey division''' was a branch of the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]]. After mapping the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], the Planetary Survey division believed that the [[Yevetha]] had set a speed record for extra-[[Star system/Legends|system]] colonization without the use of [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>
